Hi,
 my data set is of production of a crop from 1948 to 2011. It is nonseasonal as well.i simply import two column from excel.one is y=production and other is x= date.and use the following script
 ggplot(data=ct,aes(x=date,y=production)) + geom_line() +scale_x_date(limits=c(as.Date("1948"),as.Date("2011"))) 
ct is my file name. but r is giving error.

 Error in charToDate(x) : 
  character string is not in a standard unambiguous format
what to do.?? can anybody help me.

messages.author: 373beb702917b8b5
messages.subject: Re:
parts:
"1948" is a year, not a date. For as.Date you need a month and day as
well, e.g.,

scale_x_date(limits=c(as.Date("1948-01-01"),as.Date("2011-01-01")))

Best,
Ista
